input: Set a weekly step goal on my fitness tracker

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Different devices and apps (Fitbit, Garmin, Apple Watch, Google Fit, etc.) have completely different interfaces and settings menus — the steps to set a goal vary entirely by platform.
Some trackers only support daily step goals natively, not weekly ones — knowing whether the user wants a true weekly target or a daily average that sums to a weekly total changes the approach.
The user's current fitness level and any physical limitations directly determine what a realistic and safe step goal number should be.
Knowing whether the goal is for weight loss, general health, training, or a personal challenge shapes what step count to aim for and how aggressive to set the target.
Whether the user wants to set the goal via a smartphone app, a desktop app, or directly on the device itself affects which specific instructions to provide.
If the goal is being set for someone else (e.g., a child, elderly parent, or coaching client), access permissions and appropriate targets will differ.
The user may want a fixed static goal, or prefer a dynamic/adaptive goal that adjusts week-to-week based on past performance — this changes which feature or workaround to use.

gold.taskTitle: Set a weekly step goal on fitness tracker
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to configure a weekly step goal on their fitness tracker device or app.

questions.title: Which fitness tracker or app are you using?
questions.description: Identify the specific device or platform (e.g., Fitbit, Garmin, Apple Watch, Samsung Health, Google Fit) to provide accurate step-by-step instructions.

questions.title: Do you want a weekly total or a daily step target?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants one combined weekly step number or a per-day average, since many trackers only support daily goals natively.

questions.title: What specific step count are you aiming for?
questions.description: Determine the actual number the user has in mind, or whether they need help calculating an appropriate goal based on their baseline activity.

questions.title: What is the main purpose behind setting this goal?
questions.description: Understand the motivation — weight loss, general wellness, athletic training, or a personal challenge — to recommend the right target and goal type.

questions.title: Will you set this through the app or on the device itself?
questions.description: Determine the preferred interface — mobile app, web dashboard, or directly on the wearable — to give the most relevant navigation instructions.

questions.title: Are you setting this goal for yourself or someone else?
questions.description: Establish who the goal is for, as setting it for another user (e.g., a child or client) may require different account access or parental controls.

questions.title: Should the goal stay fixed or adjust based on your progress?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants a static weekly target or an adaptive goal that automatically increases or recalibrates based on recent performance.
